fields.value: The impact of functional movement variability and movement creativity on sport climbing performance

dsDescriptionValue.value: The folder contains the text files of the x- and y-position data of the hip recorded during a functional movement variability test and a performance test conducted in a sportclimbing setting. Furthermore, an excel sheet with additional information is provided.

fields.value:
The dataset contains text files of the position data collected in two different tests. The naming is as follows: P... is the number of the participant, than followed by C for the creativity test and P for the performance test and finally the number of the attempt / trajectory performed named as T... This results in the following naming of the files: P01_C_T01 is the first succesful trajectory of the first participant on the creativity test.

Finally, an excel with the outcome of dependent variable for each participant is included. This excel file also contains extra information such as birth date, length and weight. 

The matlab script that is used to process the text files with the position data into the outcomes of the dependent variables is currently being processed to make it readible for the public and will than be added here as well.
